verses.en: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
verses.pt: O SENHOR disse a Abrão: “Sai da tua terra, e da tua parentela, e da casa de teu pai, para terra que eu te mostrarei.
verses.en_web: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
verses.en_bbe: Now the Lord said to Abram, Go out from your country and from your family and from your father's house, into the land to which I will be your guide:

verses.en: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
verses.pt: E farei de ti uma grande nação, e te abençoarei, e engrandecerei o teu nome, e tu serás uma bênção.
verses.en_web: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make of you a great nation, blessing you and making your name great; and you will be a blessing:

verses.en: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
verses.pt: E abençoarei os que te abençoarem, e amaldiçoarei os que te amaldiçoarem; e em ti todas as famílias da terra serão benditas.”
verses.en_web: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treates you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
verses.en_bbe: To them who are good to you will I give blessing, and on him who does you wrong will I put my curse: and you will become a name of blessing to all the families of the earth.

verses.en: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
verses.pt: Assim se foi Abrão, como o SENHOR lhe dissera; e Ló foi com ele. Abrão tinha setenta e cinco anos de idade quando saiu de Harã.
verses.en_web: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
verses.en_bbe: So Abram went as the Lord had said to him, and Lot went with him: Abram was seventy-five years old when he went away from Haran.

verses.en: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
verses.pt: E Abrão tomou a Sarai, sua mulher, e a Ló, filho de seu irmão, e todos os seus pertences que haviam ganhado, e as pessoas que eles haviam adquirido em Harã, e saíram para ir à terra de Canaã; e à terra de Canaã chegaram.
verses.en_web: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: And Abram took Sarai, his wife, and Lot, his brother's son, and all their goods and the servants which they had got in Haran, and they went out to go to the land of Canaan.

verses.en: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
verses.pt: E passou Abrão por aquela terra até o lugar de Siquém, até o carvalho de Moré; e os cananeus estavam então na terra.
verses.en_web: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.
verses.en_bbe: And Abram went through the land till he came to Shechem, to the holy tree of Moreh. At that time, the Canaanites were still living in the land.

verses.en: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR apareceu a Abrão, e lhe disse: À tua descendência darei esta terra. E ele edificou ali um altar ao SENHOR, que lhe havia aparecido.
verses.en_web: Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to Yahweh, who had appeared to him.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord came to Abram, and said, I will give all this land to your seed; then Abram made an altar there to the Lord who had let himself be seen by him.

verses.en: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
verses.pt: E passou-se dali a um monte ao oriente de Betel, e estendeu sua tenda, tendo a Betel ao ocidente e Ai ao oriente: e edificou ali altar ao SENHOR e invocou o nome do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to Yahweh and called on Yahweh’s name.
verses.en_bbe: And moving on from there to the mountain on the east of Beth-el, he put up his tent, having Beth-el on the west and Ai on the east: and there he made an altar and gave worship to the name of the Lord.

verses.en: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
verses.pt: E moveu Abrão dali, caminhando e indo até o Sul.
verses.en_web: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.
verses.en_bbe: And he went on, journeying still to the South.

verses.en: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
verses.pt: E houve fome na terra, e desceu Abrão ao Egito para peregrinar ali; porque era grande a fome na terra.
verses.en_web: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.
verses.en_bbe: And because there was little food to be had in that land, he went down into Egypt.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
verses.pt: E aconteceu que quando estava para entrar no Egito, disse a Sarai sua mulher: Eis que, agora conheço que és mulher bela à vista;
verses.en_web: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.
verses.en_bbe: Now when he came near to Egypt, he said to Sarai, his wife, Truly, you are a fair woman and beautiful to the eye;

verses.en: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
verses.pt: E será que quando te houverem visto os egípcios, dirão: Sua mulher é: e matarão a mim, e a ti te preservarão a vida.
verses.en_web: It will happen, when the Egyptians see you, that they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.
verses.en_bbe: And I am certain that when the men of Egypt see you, they will say, This is his wife: and they will put me to death and keep you.

verses.en: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, dize que és minha irmã, para que eu vá bem por tua causa, e viva minha alma por causa de ti.
verses.en_web: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”
verses.en_bbe: Say, then, that you are my sister, and so it will be well with me because of you, and my life will be kept safe on your account.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, quando entrou Abrão no Egito, os egípcios viram a mulher que era bela em grande maneira.
verses.en_web: When Abram had come into Egypt, Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
verses.en_bbe: And so it was that when Abram came into Egypt, the men of Egypt, looking on the woman, saw that she was fair.

verses.en: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.pt: Viram-na também os príncipes de Faraó, e a elogiaram; e foi levada a mulher a casa de Faraó:
verses.en_web: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh's great men, having seen her, said words in praise of her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into Pharaoh's house.

verses.en: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
verses.pt: E fez bem a Abrão por causa dela; e teve ovelhas, e vacas, e asnos, e servos, e criadas, e asnas e camelos.
verses.en_web: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
verses.en_bbe: And because of her, he was good to Abram, and he had sheep and oxen and asses, and men-servants and women-servants, and camels.

verses.en: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.
verses.pt: Mas o SENHOR feriu a Faraó e à sua casa com grandes pragas, por causa de Sarai mulher de Abrão.
verses.en_web: Yahweh afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord sent great troubles on Pharaoh's house because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

verses.en: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
verses.pt: Então Faraó chamou a Abrão e lhe disse: Que é isto que fizeste comigo? Por que não me declaraste que era tua mulher?
verses.en_web: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?
verses.en_bbe: Then Pharaoh sent for Abram, and said, What have you done to me? why did you not say that she was your wife?

verses.en: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
verses.pt: Por que disseste: “É minha irmã”, pondo-me em risco de tomá-la para mim por mulher? Agora, pois, eis aqui tua mulher, toma-a e vai-te.
verses.en_web: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”
verses.en_bbe: Why did you say that she was your sister? so that I took her for my wife: now, take your wife and go on your way.

verses.en: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.pt: Então Faraó deu ordem a seus homens acerca de Abrão; e lhe acompanharam, e à sua mulher com tudo o que tinha.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh gave orders to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and all he had.
